title: THE HIDDEN DISEASE THREATENING AUSTRALIA'S KOALAS
caption: Koala vaccine research is promising, but scientists are still testing how well it protects wild populations. 🐨 #Koala #WildlifeScience #Conservation #AnimalFacts #WildVox

narration_timeline.text: Koalas look peaceful, but a hidden infection threatens many of them.
narration_timeline.scene: Open on a healthy real koala before the health threat is introduced

narration_timeline.text: Chlamydia can damage their eyes and reproductive systems.
narration_timeline.scene: Stay on authentic koala footage; do not invent medical imagery

narration_timeline.text: Antibiotics help, but can disrupt microbes koalas need to digest eucalyptus.
narration_timeline.scene: Switch to eucalyptus feeding exactly as digestion is mentioned

narration_timeline.text: Australian researchers are developing vaccines to protect them. One vaccine received regulatory approval in 2025, although scientists are still studying how well it prevents serious disease in wild populations.
narration_timeline.scene: Use varied real koala footage during the research explanation, without fake vaccination scenes

narration_timeline.text: Vaccination is promising, not a miracle cure.
narration_timeline.scene: Use a calm koala shot during the caution statement

narration_timeline.text: Koalas still need healthy habitat, veterinary care, and protection from the threats around them.
narration_timeline.scene: Finish on a koala climbing/living in habitat for the conservation payoff
